findings.description: Directly inspected V139 front, back, three-quarter, left, right, neutral, arms-up, arm-cross, crouch, sit, and prone renders. Chest, waist, side seams, and hip/skirt junction retain conspicuous faceted triangular patches and overlapping surfaces; the garment surface is visibly discontinuous.

V139 front, back, and both profile renders still read as a broad smooth cone with a sharp projecting waist shelf. Two folds per drafted panel are not legible at the rendered viewing scale, so the skirt does not read as the specified sewn pleated panels.

Direct pose review shows the crouch and sit views bunch the front panels against the thighs and expose the underlying shorts; rear layers protrude below the hem. Prone shows a broad rigid-looking fan of overlapping angular panels. Coverage, drape, and pose deformation are unacceptable.

nextAction: Keep candidate REJECTED and prototype-only. Correct torso/hip surface continuity and intersections, replace the smooth conical skirt with clearly readable sewn pleat panels, remove the projecting waist shelf, and repair crouch/sit/prone coverage and cloth response. Rebuild and render the complete required view/pose set for another direct review. Fit, weights, UV, Unity, and VRChat gates remain independently unverified.
